pages.about: Bramble Pet Co. has been supplying food, accessories and grooming products for dogs and cats since 2019. We stock what our own vets and groomers recommend, and we will happily tell a customer that a cheaper item is the better choice.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery, unopened and in original packaging. Opened food may be returned within 14 days if your pet refuses it; we will refund and donate the remainder to a local shelter. Faulty items replaced or refunded in full.
pages.shipping_policy: Standard shipping $5.50, free over $50, delivered in 2-4 business days. Large bags of food over 10kg ship on a separate pallet-assisted service at no extra cost.
pages.subscription_terms: Repeat food deliveries every 2, 4 or 8 weeks at a 5% discount. Skip, reschedule or cancel from your account at any time. No minimum term.
